LanguageData.FB_FleshRelayAntenna.label: relay antenna
LanguageData.FB_FleshRelayAntenna.description:
A cage of humming bioferrite frames with living fleshbeasts strapped inside. It floods the local psychic band with their own severed signal, and the colony’s beasts lose the hive. Some go mad where they stand; others answer the call and walk into the cage themselves.
Break it and everything held inside comes back.
